responsibility: Implements the front end's growable output buffer used for source regeneration, diagnostics, mangling, and token rendering. `OutBuffer` manages dynamic byte storage and offers append, prepend, insert, remove, formatting, integer and UTF encoders, indentation-aware writes, and null-terminated views or transfers of the accumulated text.
same_name_distinction: Implements OutBuffer’s storage growth, insertion/removal, formatting, encoding, indentation, and extraction behavior; unlike outbuffer.h, it contains the mutable buffer algorithms rather than just the class definition and method declarations.
